notes: Cross-verse split with EZK.34.18 and EZK.34.15. The ASV supplies a preposition to reach the bare complement of רעה in all three places; 34.18 and 34.15 keep it with the verb under rule 44, while 34.14 gave it to the noun under rule 33. Nothing in the source licenses the difference: מִרְעֶה carries no preposition and no object marker in either verse, and it is the verb's own complement rather than an adverbial accusative, so rule 44's second limit governs. The on of on fat pasture moves from מִרְעֶה to תִּרְעֶינָה, whose unit is discontinuous around fat pasture under rule 25 and still heads on feed. No other unit in the verse changes.
